title: CrowdStrike says the average breakout time for attackers moving from intrusion to other network systems fell to 29 minutes in 2025, a 65% YoY increase in speed (Matt Kapko/CyberScoop)
summary: Matt Kapko / CyberScoop: CrowdStrike says the average breakout time for attackers moving from intrusion to other network systems fell to 29 minutes in 2025, a 65% YoY increase in speed — The average time from intrusion to network movement in 2025 was 29 minutes, a 65% increase in speed from the year prior. — Learn more.
